Each row carries the selection of record at its pin of record, the verdict under the rules below, the row's evidence class (none_recorded when any winner's acceptance is none_recorded, otherwise a class that at least one winner's acceptance carries; stronger evidence for one winner stays in the reasons), the reasons with their sources, and the ordered steps a session runs on the new distribution. Every evidence class describes historical evidence from the source host: a new distribution collects its own evidence, and nothing in this edition is acceptance on it. Upstream currency was read on 2026-10-01 with one bounded read per pinned winner (the GitHub releases page, or the named registry page where the project publishes no GitHub release). Paths not yet on main are cited through their pull request and are not hashed.
verdict_rules: a layer is "closed" only when all five close_only_when items of research-state.json hold; otherwise "selection_of_record_open" with the missing items named

the winner cell carries the pin of record only (manifests/stack.json or adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json for stack components; catalogs/us-equities/runtime-target.json for the engine and brokers; the adoption profile recipes for install commands)
paper results count only as fills and passed trials
upstream and user-side gates are gates

verdict_values.closed: All five close_only_when items of the research state hold for this row.
verdict_values.selection_of_record_open: A selection of record exists at its pin of record, and at least one closure item does not hold; the row names what is missing.
verdict_values.provisional: The selection of record stays the install default, but its owner marks it contested; a named comparison decides before any claim beyond installation.
verdict_values.comparison_required: The research state or the row's owner requires a representative comparison that has not run; the selection stands only until it does.
verdict_values.new_host_required: The remaining closure evidence can only be collected on a new host.
verdict_values.no_selection: No selection of record exists for this row in this edition.

evidence_classes.upstream_test: Upstream test: an unchanged upstream test or suite at a recorded revision, with its returned result
evidence_classes.upstream_example_or_native_operation: Upstream example or native operation: a supported command or published example with its actual returned output
evidence_classes.local_integration_check: Local integration check: our integration of upstream behaviors with an explicit oracle, never an upstream test
evidence_classes.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic fixture: constructed frozen data with expected results, never production evidence
evidence_classes.independent_observation: Independent observation: direct inspection of artifacts or state by a separate method
evidence_classes.structural_validation: Structural validation: schema, references, hashes or contract tests; not execution
evidence_classes.source_review: Source review or release metadata only: no execution (below the policy table; AGENTS.md keeps metadata, pinned source review and native execution apart)
evidence_classes.none_recorded: No acceptance is recorded for this row or for at least one of its winners

rows.title: Convergence practice: evidence classes, validators and closure

winners.name: Convergence practice and its validators (this repository)

acceptance.command: python3 scripts/validate.py; python3 scripts/validate_catalogs.py; python3 scripts/build_ecosystem.py --check

upstream_currency.latest_release: not applicable: this repository's own practice at this edition's base commit

closure.missing: c1: the practice is written down, but the research state and the layer records disagree on which layers require a comparison (comparison_required against keep_but_compare); c2: no closure assessment of the practice itself exists; c3: the structural checks pass in CI, but no layer has completed the closure loop on a new host; c4: no independent review of the practice as a whole; c5: no closure record.

reasons.text: Eight practices: the task envelope as the entry point; review against the gap a component would close; instructions, retrieval and durable state kept distinct; one owner per worker on an actual base; native context and cache preserved; every attempt counted; deterministic checks separate from live qualification; a recoverable closing decision.

Evidence classes stay separate (unchanged upstream tests, native operation, local integration, synthetic fixtures, independent observation, structural validation), and a new claim needs a discriminating control.

A host receipt counts toward a status only at a version that matches a current winner pin: the recorder refuses other versions unless --allow-unbound-version, so verdict pins are re-recorded before new-distribution receipts are collected.
Closure records are registered through the research state's closure_refs, which the landscape build reads.

new_host_steps: Clone origin/main and run the three structural checks.
Before collecting new-distribution host receipts, re-record each layer's verdict pins with tools/sota-convergence/record_verdicts.py so that scripts/host_receipts.py binds the installed versions.
Collect each layer's host receipts with `python3 scripts/host_receipts.py record`, keeping every failed attempt and one negative control per new claim.
Write each layer's dated closure record and register it in catalogs/landscape/research-state.json closure_refs; a layer closes only when all five items hold.

gates.text: Each layer closes only after its comparison, an independent review and a closure record; this edition closes none.
